title: Bevy World Inspector
summary: Run and inspect a colliding headless Bevy ECS world through an instance-scoped Vooya Rust Store while Vue owns the complete product interface.
question: Can a feature-configured Bevy ECS crate compile through Vooya without dependency translation and expose a bounded world snapshot to Vue?
interactions: run or pause the ECS schedule
evidence: exact Bevy ECS Cargo version and features
real World, Query, and Schedule execute in WASM
custom elastic contacts update ECS components
host render FPS and ECS step rate remain distinct
focused browser test covers lifecycle actions

hostOwns: DOM world projection and entity inspector
rustOwns: movement, boundary, pair-contact, energy, and pulse systems
elastic contact resolution and impact state
spawn, despawn, selection validity, and snapshots

inputs: coarse Store actions with primitive arguments
outputs: one cached structured world snapshot with at most 48 agents
boundary.updatePattern: One bounded ECS step runs every 40ms while active and publishes one coalesced snapshot; host requestAnimationFrame measures presentation separately.
